scope: 100 x 10 m acceptance on the default inspection road with the lightweight GZ display meshes adopted. Compared against default_2mm_closure_1 of 2026-09-16, which predates three separate changes, so the totals below are their combined effect, not this one.
attribution: chassis ready falls 44.7 s against the 09-16 baseline, but that baseline predates the derived-asset cache, the independent OptiX reader optimisation and this mesh change. Measured on this road against runs that already had the first two, the mesh share is about -16.9 s on the mean. The three should not be added from this table.
vram_reading: first VRAM figure for the light mesh: 8.96 to 5.90 GiB. It falls less than RSS because the display textures are untouched and dominate what is left on the device, which is the case for doing the texture half if VRAM is the constraint.

handshake_brake.detection: stop intervals below 0.05 m/s for at least 0.3 s, then the peak speed between consecutive stops inside one track-end cluster. Turnaround creep peaks at 0.05 to 0.62 m/s; the event re-accelerates to about 1.5 m/s to cover the remaining distance, as docs/issues/CAPTURE_CLOSE_HANDSHAKE_BRAKE.md describes.
handshake_brake.operator_report: the operator called out the sixth track end while watching this run
handshake_brake.rate_history: 3/10, 2/10, 0/10 before, 1/10 here: 6 of 40 track ends, about 15%, unchanged
handshake_brake.note: this run did not use the pause probe, so no stop here is the validator pausing

same_day_default_road_plateau.scope: both launches today on the same machine, default inspection road, derived cache warm, clean instance before each. The only difference is which manifest: manifest.json carries display_mesh, manifest_full_visual.json does not.
same_day_default_road_plateau.why: isolates the mesh share on the default road itself, without the derived cache and OptiX reader changes that sit between this and the 09-16 baseline

full_detail_still_available.validated: both manifests pass the shipped validator; the full one declares no display_mesh, so the visual is the optical mesh under the ordinary rule
full_detail_still_available.render_backend: refused on the light scene, allowed on the full one

operator_confirmed.gui_and_rviz_by_eye: confirmed by the operator while watching the full-area run, not by this assistant; no screenshot was captured
operator_confirmed.lidar_returns: the operator accepted the change without a comparison. The display mesh drops joints up to 3 mm deep, and nothing in the workspace subscribes to the point clouds, so nothing downstream sees it.
